fact: On 19 January 2024 minister Tahina Razafindramalo presented the five-year Plan stratégique du numérique (PSN) to 2028 at Antaninarenina, with a stated financial need of USD 800 million of which 500 million is available.
title: Stratégie numérique : le PSN accompagne l'émergence d'une économie numérique à Madagascar
